evidence.note: The verse gives the two wives’ names in parallel, first Adah and then Zillah.
כַּלָּה תַּעְדֶּה כֵלֶיהָ describes a bride adorning herself with her jewels, illustrating the verbal sense proposed for the name’s derivation.

name: עָדָה
summary: Genesis names Adah as one of Lamech’s two wives. Her name may be related to the verb עָדָה, “to adorn.” Genesis gives no explanation of its meaning.
